pages.text: $(bold)Durandal$()$(br2)Obtaining: evolves from a tool whose $(bold)every part is Durandal$() (cast each part from Molten Durandal at the Casting Table and assemble it) — a Tinkers' $(l)sword$(), $(l)cleaver$() or $(l)flying sword$() built that way is converted into the Durandal Sword as soon as you hold it.$(br2)Features:$(li)made of $(bold)Durandal$() material, it natively carries the $(l:traits/trait_unbreakable)Unbreakable$() trait — $(bold)never takes damage$()$(li)a legendary-grade weapon with extremely high base stats
